sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Direct PhD from bachelor’s possible; mathematics competence and GPA>=3.0 over last 60 credit hours.
International applicant eligible. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use CollegeNet/ApplyWeb; upload passport front page, degree/transcript records, CV, statement and referee
contacts. No supervisor agreement needed. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No pre-application contact or supervisor needed for admission/funding; program questions to Alan
Haynes,akhaynes@central.uh.edu. [s2]
Portal workflow [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
FAQ freshly updated October 26, 2026; deadlines standing and no 2027 stipend figure. [s2]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Conflict]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Admission and TA English standards distinct. TA alternatives: TOEFL speaking 25, IELTS speaking 7.5, DET
conversation 120/production 105, ACTFL Advanced High, or qualifying degree. Current new-scale equivalents
should be checked with Graduate School. [s2] [s5]

UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
FAQ expressly allows finishing an accredited U.S. degree, provided completed before program begins;
completed U.S. bachelor’s also meets TA English requirement. If degree unfinished, testing needed. [s2] [s5]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
GRE waived for all mathematics graduate applications; FAQ says supplied scores unlikely to affect decision. Not
described as prohibited. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three; at least 1 professional mathematician, preferably all 3. [s1]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
RA mainly continuing students with research supervisor; university/NSM fellowships via department nomination
consider 3 references and academic/research goals. No extra reference explicitly required; external awards
have their own eligibility. [s1] [s5]
What sends the invitation; Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Central says email instructions are sent once applicant submits referee emails; final application submission
prerequisite not expressly stated. Letters only through electronic system, not email. [s3]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Portal lists materials received, including missing recommendations. Follow up directly with referee. [s2]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
TA monthly salary/benefits for 9-month year; exact 2027 amount unverified. GTF pays 9 credits/semester
tuition/fees, excess credits charged resident rate. [s1]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Typically up to 5 years with satisfactory progress, offer controls; GTF maximum 5 years. TAs tutor, lead
recitations/grade rather than usually teach own courses. [s1] [s2]
International eligibility; Extra funding application [Standing rule]
International applicants can receive funded PhD; complete PhD application automatically considered, no
separate application. English appointment rules must be met. [s1] [s2]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Assistantships require full-time graduate study; outside part-time work needs approval. Fall 2026 insurance
support is taxable salary supplements in November/March, not direct premium payment; F/J SHIP billed
separately unless approved waiver. [s5] [s6]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
RA mainly continuing students with research supervisor; university/NSM fellowships via department nomination
consider 3 references and academic/research goals. No extra reference explicitly required; external awards
have their own eligibility. [s1] [s5]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International fee $80 nonrefundable. [s1]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Mathematics generally does not provide fee waivers. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic and complex geometry
Gordon Heier
Curvature/positivity, hyperbolicity, effective geometry, Diophantine approximation. [s7]

Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · Biholomorphic rigidity and symmetry breaking for domains with Bergman metric of constant
positive holomorphic sectional curvature
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Complex and arithmetic geometry
Min Ru
Nevanlinna theory, hyperbolicity, Diophantine approximation and minimal surfaces. [s8]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · Vojta’s conjecture for entire curves in toric varieties highly ramified over the boundary
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Complex geometry
Shanyu Ji
Several complex variables, CR geometry and rigidity of proper holomorphic mappings between balls. The
reviewed official list stops at 2021, so a more recent dated paper remains unverified. [s9] [q11]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2021 submitted manuscript on official list · A map of degree 3 from n-ball into (3n-2)-ball is determined by
its 3-jets
Research-paper evidence. Publication year is as stated; an old paper is not proof of recent activity.
Number theory (dynamical)
Alan Haynes
Diophantine approximation, uniform distribution, geometry of numbers, and quasicrystals/cut-and-project sets.
[s10] [q12]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Gaps theorems for linear forms with cubic coefficients
Research-paper evidence. Publication year is as stated; an old paper is not proof of recent activity.

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Direct PhD from bachelor’s possible; mathematics competence and GPA>=3.0 over last 60 credit hours.
International applicant eligible. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use CollegeNet/ApplyWeb; upload passport front page, degree/transcript records, CV, statement and referee
contacts. No supervisor agreement needed. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No pre-application contact or supervisor needed for admission/funding; program questions to Alan
Haynes,akhaynes@central.uh.edu. [s2]
Portal workflow [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
FAQ freshly updated October 26, 2026; deadlines standing and no 2027 stipend figure. [s2]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Conflict]
Department: January 15 priority, April 1 regular, standing dates. Central table instead lists May 1 international
PhD deadline; use earlier departmental date and confirm conflict. [s1] [s4]
Funding consideration; Reference receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
All materials by January 15 for priority funding; automatic consideration,15-20 funded places anticipated. No
distinct recommendation grace period stated. [s1] [s2]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
FAQ permits later English scores if noted in statement; no offer until scores arrive. Do not assume other
required materials have an extension. [s2]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Admission and TA English standards distinct. TA alternatives: TOEFL speaking 25, IELTS speaking 7.5, DET
conversation 120/production 105, ACTFL Advanced High, or qualifying degree. Current new-scale equivalents
should be checked with Graduate School. [s2] [s5]

UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
FAQ expressly allows finishing an accredited U.S. degree, provided completed before program begins;
completed U.S. bachelor’s also meets TA English requirement. If degree unfinished, testing needed. [s2] [s5]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
GRE waived for all mathematics graduate applications; FAQ says supplied scores unlikely to affect decision. Not
described as prohibited. [s1] [s2]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
All postsecondary transcripts and degree diplomas; FAQ permits unofficial review copies, official after
admission despite main-page official wording. [s1] [s2]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Not listed as a separate required item on the public mathematics application checklist. This does not establish
whether the current portal permits an optional upload; exact prompt, length, formatting and upload/link rule
are not published. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three; at least 1 professional mathematician, preferably all 3. [s1]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
RA mainly continuing students with research supervisor; university/NSM fellowships via department nomination
consider 3 references and academic/research goals. No extra reference explicitly required; external awards
have their own eligibility. [s1] [s5]
What sends the invitation; Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Central says email instructions are sent once applicant submits referee emails; final application submission
prerequisite not expressly stated. Letters only through electronic system, not email. [s3]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Portal lists materials received, including missing recommendations. Follow up directly with referee. [s2]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required resume: mathematical work, teaching, prizes/awards. Papers under review may be listed with short
summary and status. [s1] [s2]
Statement of purpose; Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
One-page Interests and Goals statement; motivation, expected training, mathematics preferences/research
and career goals (paraphrased). No further format rule published. [s1]
Personal / background statement; Research proposal; Course-list document; Other short answers /
materials [Standing rule]
Not listed as a separate required item on the public mathematics application checklist. This does not establish
whether the current portal permits an optional upload; exact prompt, length, formatting and upload/link rule
are not published. [s1]

Writing sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list [Standing rule]
Research/publications are not required; submitted/under-review papers may be described on CV with
status/summary. Separate paper upload/link permission not established. [s2]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
TA monthly salary/benefits for 9-month year; exact 2027 amount unverified. GTF pays 9 credits/semester
tuition/fees, excess credits charged resident rate. [s1]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Typically up to 5 years with satisfactory progress, offer controls; GTF maximum 5 years. TAs tutor, lead
recitations/grade rather than usually teach own courses. [s1] [s2]
International eligibility; Extra funding application [Standing rule]
International applicants can receive funded PhD; complete PhD application automatically considered, no
separate application. English appointment rules must be met. [s1] [s2]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Assistantships require full-time graduate study; outside part-time work needs approval. Fall 2026 insurance
support is taxable salary supplements in November/March, not direct premium payment; F/J SHIP billed
separately unless approved waiver. [s5] [s6]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
RA mainly continuing students with research supervisor; university/NSM fellowships via department nomination
consider 3 references and academic/research goals. No extra reference explicitly required; external awards
have their own eligibility. [s1] [s5]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International fee $80 nonrefundable. [s1]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Mathematics generally does not provide fee waivers. [s1] [s2]
